name: ASCENDANT GRID: Spire Social Conquest Sim
description: A full-neural social simulation where players inhabit lives in GLMZ's Tier 5 Spire — navigating corporate politics, social hierarchies, inheritance games, and the specific cruelties of ultra-elite culture with BCI-fidelity sensory and emotional immersion. Published by Sovereign Entertainment as a prestige product, ASCENDANT GRID is enormously popular in Tier 3-4 as aspirational fantasy, and quietly beloved in the Spire itself as a flattering mirror. The game's fidelity to actual Tier 5 social dynamics was so precise at launch that a minor scandal erupted over which Spire families had been consulted in its creation.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 player has spent Φ4,000 on ASCENDANT GRID subscriptions over two years and has become a recognized expert on Spire social protocols — which attracts the attention of a real Spire family who needs someone with exactly that knowledge for a real task.
One of the game's 'fictional' Spire characters is a perfect neural model of a real person who disappeared in 2218 — and they're trying to communicate something through the simulation.
A Sovereign Entertainment developer leaks evidence that ASCENDANT GRID's ongoing narrative updates are being written based on real intercepted Spire communications.
